qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Panel manufacturing scale and regulatory product certifications. Dense regional manufacturing network minimizes bulky freight costs. Demonstrated pricing power by passing through massive raw chemical (MDI/polyol/steel) cost inflation in 2021-2023. Multi-year median GAAP ROIC is 14.1% and operating tangible ROIC is 36.7%.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global leader in high-performance insulated sandwich panels and advanced building envelopes. Structural moat derived from dense regional manufacturing footprint minimizing bulky transport costs, proprietary QuadCore formulations, and regulatory fire/thermal certifications. Resilient peak-to-peak EPS compounding across European construction cycles backed by EU building decarbonization regulations. Sound balance sheet with net debt of 2.2x NI and 12x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: building efficiency volume 3.5% + QuadCore/data center mix 2.5% + pricing power 2.0% - cyclical/capex drag 0.5% + buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 14.1% with operating tangible ROIC of 36.7%. Owner EPS compounded consistently from 3.27 EUR in 2022 to a peak of 3.67 EUR in 2025. Multi-year Owner FCF conversion reached 95.7%. Net debt / NI is 2.23x (1,495.8m EUR net debt vs 671.2m EUR NI) with interest coverage of 11.97x (EBIT 929.1m EUR vs interest 77.6m EUR).
